desc: Implement the fixed-\(S\) feasibility criterion using frequency counts and prove it handles capacities, multiplicities, and nonnegative completions.
Accumulate matching capacities by candidate sum in \(O(U_AU_B)\), avoiding an \(O(N^3)\) per-candidate scan.
Handle the case \(r=0\), where a sufficiently large common sum need not equal any fixed-pair sum.
Produce the final Python program with stdin parsing and exactly `Yes`/`No` output.
